title: Basil server configuration
description: Basil-specific settings read from Data/appsettings.json. ASP.NET and library settings, such as Kestrel, AllowedHosts, ConnectionStrings, and Logging:LogLevel, are documented by their owners. Policies that can change while the server runs, including rate limits, locks, sessions, and uploads, are stored in the database and changed through the HTTP API or console. You can also set any key with an environment variable (Basil__Server__Domain) or a command-line argument (--Basil:Server:Domain=...). These values override the file.

Logging.description: Basil's own log file and queue settings.

File.description: Settings for log files. Changes take effect after the server restarts.

Location.description: Folder for log files, relative to the executable.

Interval.description: Start a new file after this interval.

MaxSize.description: Start a new file at this size, for example 100MB, even if the interval has not ended. Leave empty or set to 0 for no limit.

MaxAge.description: How long to keep a log file after its last write, in d.hh:mm:ss format. Set to 0 for no limit.

MaxFiles.description: Maximum number of log files to keep, newest first. Set to 0 for no limit.

MaxSize.description: Maximum total size of kept log files, for example 1GB. Leave empty or set to 0 for no limit.

QueueCapacity.description: Number of log events that can wait to be written before newer events are dropped and counted. Changes take effect after the server restarts.

OpenTelemetry.description: OpenTelemetry export settings. Disabled by default. Changes take effect after the server restarts.

Server.description: Server identity and public address. Changes take effect after the server restarts.

Name.description: Name the server uses for itself, including in telemetry.

Domain.description: Public domain clients use to reach the server. This must not be an IP address.

TrustedProxies.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges trusted to provide client address and country headers.

Port.description: Plain TCP port for the IRC host. Every connection must start with a PROXY protocol v1 header from a trusted proxy; the proxy in front ends TLS. Set to 0 to use a free port.

AccelPrefix.description: Location of the reverse proxy that serves the Data folder (for example /_files/). When set, stored files are sent by the proxy through X-Accel-Redirect; when empty, Basil sends them itself.

Assets.description: Changes take effect after the server restarts.

CacheDirectory.description: Folder for temporary files created while building audio previews. Leave empty to use Previews in the storage location's cache.

Database.description: Database settings. Changes take effect after the server restarts.

PoolSize.description: Maximum number of connections in the read pool. Set to 0 to use the driver's default.
Maximum number of connections that can write changes at the same time.

Updates.description: Checks for newer releases and never installs them. Changes take effect immediately.

Source.description: GitHub repository URL whose latest release is compared with the running version.

CheckOnStartup.description: Check for a newer release when the server starts.
